in_marathi.name: Sudhakar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे One who has good knowledge
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sudhakar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sudha means purity and Kar means doer. Thus, Sudhakar is a name given to one who has good knowledge or is a learned man.

in_bengali.name: Sudhakar
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ One who has good knowledge
in_bengali.long_meaning: Sudhakar একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Sudha means purity and Kar means doer. Thus, Sudhakar is a name given to one who has good knowledge or is a learned man.
